 Follow Jennifer Love Hewitt Says She Felt She'd 'Forgotten How to Act' Before Ryan Phillippe Reunion After 29 Years
 Maja Senic Thu, November 19, 2026 at 12:00 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Image Credit: Tinseltown, DFree / Shutterstock. Jennifer Love Hewitt was excited to work with Ryan Phillippe again, but the prospect left her far more nervous than she expected.
 The former I Know What You Did Last Summer costars recently reunited on the set of ABC's 9-1-1 , teasing an upcoming crossover with 9-1-1: Nashville .
 Hewitt, 47, said she hadn't seen Phillippe, 52, since she was 18. The two had gone their separate ways after filming the 1997 horror hit.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She recalled the experience in an interview with PEOPLE conducted November 14 at the Los Angeles launch of her Raine Calabasas jewelry collaboration. Her comments were published November 17.
 Hewitt Shares a Video From Their Reunion
 Hewitt gave fans a look at the encounter on November 11, posting an Instagram video of herself walking alongside Phillippe on set. Both were in costume for their television roles.
 Before they began working, coworkers kept asking whether she was excited. Hewitt remembered having a dry mouth and a racing heart. "I feel like I've forgotten how to act," she recalled. When Phillippe arrived, he greeted her with a hug and told her they were going to have fun.
 Her children visited that day and met him, too. Hewitt was touched by how warmly he treated them. She described the experience as a "dear diary moment," saying he had the same warmth she remembered.
 Hewitt Looks Back on Their Original Horror Film
 In I Know What You Did Last Summer , Phillippe played Barry Cox, whose harsh treatment of Hewitt's Julie James stood in contrast to their relationship away from the cameras. Hewitt remembered wanting to drink Joy Cola and sit in a hot tub with him while they were making the movie, simply to hang out and become friends.
 Advertisement Advertisement When she brought up that memory during their recent shoot, Phillippe remembered it as well. She said he recalled how sweet it was that she had wanted that ordinary time together.
 Hewitt had already revisited Julie in the franchise's 2025 installment, which reunited her with Freddie Prinze Jr. as Ray Bronson. Working with Phillippe this time meant bringing a former movie costar into a television workplace she knew well.
 Phillippe Shares Reunion Photos With a 1997 Throwback
 Phillippe's November 12 Instagram post placed a new photograph from the 9-1-1 set beside a still from their earlier movie. He captioned the two-photo post, "Cat's out the bag," according to Entertainment Weekly .
 Hewitt told PEOPLE they had been sending each other private messages about fans' reactions, joking that the posts might have broken the internet.
 Phillippe Had Already Discussed a Possible Crossover
 Phillippe appeared on Good Morning America on October 14 to discuss joining 9-1-1: Nashville . His character, Detective Rogue Kelly, is a New York investigator who relocates to Tennessee. Hewitt plays emergency dispatcher Maddie Buckley-Han on the original series, a role she has held since 2018.
 Advertisement Advertisement The following day, Phillippe debuted in the spinoff's second-season premiere, "Going Rogue." ABC described his storyline as an investigation into crimes inspired by biblical plagues.
 In an October 22 interview with TV Insider , he said his detective could plausibly cross over to the flagship series. He welcomed the chance to work with Hewitt and expressed interest in sharing a scene with Angela Bassett. An episode title and airdate for his reunion with Hewitt have yet to be announced.
